_comment: Strategic-lens blind-spot categories (Locked Decision: L10/T2). EXTERNAL config, not a hard-coded enum, so the taxonomy extends without a code/schema/persisted-JSON migration. An unknown value emitted by the judge is coerced to 'other' with a logged warning (never a hard parse failure). The first six are the manual-blend reference categories the Phase-5 golden gate measures against (a11y, i18n, teaching-efficacy folded into core-assumption, success-metrics, product-viability).
